title: Wikis

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({unit="wiki-runner.service"} |~ `^(ok|failed|timeout) \S+ \S+ after ` | regexp `^(?P<status>ok|failed|timeout) \S+ (?:(?P<w>[\w-]+)/)?(?P<task>[\w-]+) after (?P<secs>\d+)s` | label_format wiki=`{{ or .w "default" }}` | wiki=~"$wiki" [$__range]))

sum(count_over_time({unit="wiki-runner.service"} |~ `^(ok|failed|timeout) \S+ \S+ after ` | regexp `^(?P<status>ok|failed|timeout) \S+ (?:(?P<w>[\w-]+)/)?(?P<task>[\w-]+) after (?P<secs>\d+)s` | label_format wiki=`{{ or .w "default" }}` | wiki=~"$wiki" | status=~"failed|timeout" [$__range]))

panels.title: Median ingest
panels.description: Each ingest job, counting each part of a long source (ingest-part) as its own job, as in Time per ingest.

targets.expr: max(quantile_over_time(0.5, {unit="wiki-runner.service"} |~ `^(ok|failed|timeout) \S+ \S+ after ` | regexp `^(?P<status>ok|failed|timeout) \S+ (?:(?P<w>[\w-]+)/)?(?P<task>[\w-]+) after (?P<secs>\d+)s` | label_format wiki=`{{ or .w "default" }}` | wiki=~"$wiki" | task=~"ingest|ingest-part" | status="ok" | unwrap secs [$__range]))

panels.title: Slowest ingest
panels.description: Each ingest job, counting each part of a long source (ingest-part) as its own job, as in Time per ingest.

targets.expr: max(max_over_time({unit="wiki-runner.service"} |~ `^(ok|failed|timeout) \S+ \S+ after ` | regexp `^(?P<status>ok|failed|timeout) \S+ (?:(?P<w>[\w-]+)/)?(?P<task>[\w-]+) after (?P<secs>\d+)s` | label_format wiki=`{{ or .w "default" }}` | wiki=~"$wiki" | task=~"ingest|ingest-part" | unwrap secs [$__range]))

panels.title: Lint in the last 26 h
panels.description: 0 means the last nightly lint didn't run (machine off or asleep). One value per wiki, whatever the Wiki picker says.

targets.expr: sum by (wiki) (count_over_time({unit="wiki-runner.service"} |~ `^(ok|failed|timeout) \S+ \S+ after ` | regexp `^(?P<status>ok|failed|timeout) \S+ (?:(?P<w>[\w-]+)/)?(?P<task>[\w-]+) after (?P<secs>\d+)s` | label_format wiki=`{{ or .w "default" }}` | task="lint" [26h])) or label_replace(vector(0), "wiki", "default", "", "")

panels.title: Raw links repaired
panels.description: Links the agent wrote to a raw folder instead of its source.md, fixed by wiki-index

targets.expr: sum by (task) (count_over_time({unit="wiki-runner.service"} |~ `^(ok|failed|timeout) \S+ \S+ after ` | regexp `^(?P<status>ok|failed|timeout) \S+ (?:(?P<w>[\w-]+)/)?(?P<task>[\w-]+) after (?P<secs>\d+)s` | label_format wiki=`{{ or .w "default" }}` | wiki=~"$wiki" [1d]))

sum by (task, status) (count_over_time({unit="wiki-runner.service"} |~ `^(ok|failed|timeout) \S+ \S+ after ` | regexp `^(?P<status>ok|failed|timeout) \S+ (?:(?P<w>[\w-]+)/)?(?P<task>[\w-]+) after (?P<secs>\d+)s` | label_format wiki=`{{ or .w "default" }}` | wiki=~"$wiki" | status=~"failed|timeout" [1d]))

panels.title: Failed, timed-out and rejected jobs (the id names the transcript folder in /var/lib/wiki-jobs/transcripts)

targets.expr: max_over_time({unit="wiki-runner.service"} |~ `^(ok|failed|timeout) \S+ \S+ after ` | regexp `^(?P<status>ok|failed|timeout) \S+ (?:(?P<w>[\w-]+)/)?(?P<task>[\w-]+) after (?P<secs>\d+)s` | label_format wiki=`{{ or .w "default" }}` | wiki=~"$wiki" | task=~"ingest|ingest-part" | unwrap secs [$__interval]) by (status)

panels.title: Ingest time per day: median and 90th percentile

targets.expr: max(quantile_over_time(0.5, {unit="wiki-runner.service"} |~ `^(ok|failed|timeout) \S+ \S+ after ` | regexp `^(?P<status>ok|failed|timeout) \S+ (?:(?P<w>[\w-]+)/)?(?P<task>[\w-]+) after (?P<secs>\d+)s` | label_format wiki=`{{ or .w "default" }}` | wiki=~"$wiki" | task="ingest" | status="ok" | unwrap secs [1d]))

max(quantile_over_time(0.9, {unit="wiki-runner.service"} |~ `^(ok|failed|timeout) \S+ \S+ after ` | regexp `^(?P<status>ok|failed|timeout) \S+ (?:(?P<w>[\w-]+)/)?(?P<task>[\w-]+) after (?P<secs>\d+)s` | label_format wiki=`{{ or .w "default" }}` | wiki=~"$wiki" | task="ingest" | status="ok" | unwrap secs [1d]))

panels.title: Sources added per day, by person and way in (chat, Karakeep app, extension, email…)

targets.expr: sum by (person, via) (count_over_time({unit=~`wikiglue(@.+)?\.service`} | label_format wiki=`{{ or .wiki "default" }}` | wiki=~"$wiki" |= `ingest queued` | regexp `(?P<person>[\w-]+)'s (?P<kind>bookmark|email) .* ingest queued(?:[^,]*)(?:, from (?P<from>.+))?$` | label_format via=`{{ if .from }}{{ .from }}{{ else }}{{ .kind }}{{ end }}` [1d]))

panels.title: Jobs per day by model server
panels.description: Which llama.cpp server ran each job

targets.expr: sum by (server) (count_over_time({unit="wiki-runner.service"} |~ `^start .* on ` | regexp `^start \S+ \(\S+ (?:(?P<w>[\w-]+)/)?(?P<task>[\w-]+)\) on (?P<server>\S+)$` | label_format wiki=`{{ or .w "default" }}` | wiki=~"$wiki" [1d]))

panels.title: Lint, morning message, shopping list and digest
Duration per run
panels.description: Lint stops after about 30 page edits and is killed at 20 minutes (_tasks/lint.md); the morning message (06:00) checks each upcoming trip, then writes the message

targets.expr: max_over_time({unit="wiki-runner.service"} |~ `^(ok|failed|timeout) \S+ \S+ after ` | regexp `^(?P<status>ok|failed|timeout) \S+ (?:(?P<w>[\w-]+)/)?(?P<task>[\w-]+) after (?P<secs>\d+)s` | label_format wiki=`{{ or .w "default" }}` | wiki=~"$wiki" | task=~"lint|morning|shopping|digest" | unwrap secs [1d]) by (wiki, task, status)

panels.title: Shopping list in the last 8 days
Digest in the last 8 days
panels.description: One value per wiki, whatever the Wiki picker says.

targets.expr: sum by (wiki) (count_over_time({unit="wiki-runner.service"} |~ `^(ok|failed|timeout) \S+ \S+ after ` | regexp `^(?P<status>ok|failed|timeout) \S+ (?:(?P<w>[\w-]+)/)?(?P<task>[\w-]+) after (?P<secs>\d+)s` | label_format wiki=`{{ or .w "default" }}` | task="digest" [8d])) or label_replace(vector(0), "wiki", "default", "", "")

panels.title: Morning message in the last 26 h
panels.description: 0 means this morning's message didn't run (machine off, or no model server)

targets.expr: sum(sum_over_time({unit="wiki-runner.service"} |~ `^(ok|failed|timeout) \S+ (\S+/)?lint after ` | regexp `^(ok|failed|timeout) \S+ (?:(?P<w>[\w-]+)/)?lint after \d+s \(paused (?P<paused>\d+)s\)` | label_format wiki=`{{ or .w "default" }}` | wiki=~"$wiki" | unwrap paused [$__range]))

max_over_time({unit="wiki-runner.service"} |~ `^(ok|failed|timeout) \S+ \S+ after ` | regexp `^(?P<status>ok|failed|timeout) \S+ (?:(?P<w>[\w-]+)/)?(?P<task>[\w-]+) after (?P<secs>\d+)s` | label_format wiki=`{{ or .w "default" }}` | wiki=~"$wiki" | task="query" | unwrap secs [$__interval]) by (status)

panels.title: Plain messages routed, and routing failures, per day

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({unit=~`wikiglue(@.+)?\.service`} | label_format wiki=`{{ or .wiki "default" }}` | wiki=~"$wiki" |= "routing failed, using the default" [1d]))
targets.legendFormat: failed (fell back to saving as a source)

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({unit="wiki-site-build.service"} |= "site rebuilt" | regexp `site rebuilt(?:: (?P<w>[\w-]+))?` | label_format wiki=`{{ or .w "default" }}` | wiki=~"$wiki" [1d]))

targets.legendFormat: repairs per rebuild (pages with bad YAML)
